rewards.name: base_notation_compliance
rewards.description: Rewards base-notation answers, gives partial credit for decimal equivalents or correct digits in the requested base.

rewards.name: fraction_simplification_quality
rewards.description: Targets common-fraction answers, rewarding simplified equivalent fractions and penalizing wrong rational values.

rewards.name: pi_coefficient_partial_credit
rewards.description: Targets pi answers, comparing pi coefficients and allowing partial credit for close coefficients or decimal approximations.

rewards.name: integer_constraint_compliance
rewards.description: Targets integer-constrained questions, rewarding integer-typed predictions and penalizing non-integer or negated answers.

rewards.name: answer_verification_mention
rewards.description: Rewards explicit verification language in thinking, with higher scores for correct answers that check the result.

rewards.name: prompt_key_number_grounding
rewards.description: Rewards thinking that grounds key numeric constants from the prompt, especially for otherwise incorrect attempts.

rewards.name: solution_tag_purity
rewards.description: Rewards a clean solution tag containing only the final answer, penalizing explanatory text, sentences, and assignments.

rewards.name: numeric_type_and_sign_partial_credit
rewards.description: Gives partial credit for numeric answers based on sign and numeric type, independent of magnitude proximity.

rewards.name: degree_angle_notation_compliance
rewards.description: Targets angle answers, rewarding degree notation and penalizing missing degree symbols or radian labels.

rewards.name: final_answer_not_equation
rewards.description: Penalizes final answers presented as equations or variable assignments when the ground truth is a plain value.
